***
gpworks is a GP mod made by RixTheTyrunt (aka Gradient Man) that turns GP into a programming language for HTTP servers.

gpworks is a ***huge*** WIP so please 🐻 bear with me

## My browser has problems with WebAssembly, can I run it locally?
gpworks aims more towards Browser than local running, so I don't think gpworks would work locally. It's just that the browser has special features...
Also it's more accessible.

But if you only want to run it locally because the WebAssembly is buggy, just add a `?js` query param (and hit me up tbh)

Note that even if the `?js=false`, `js` is still present, so gpworks will run itself in legacy JS instead of WASM.
